changedPrimitive: Full-resolution 8-bit component-row construction only: safe AVX2 loads eight complete RGBA pixels, performs the exact encoded-space alpha blend in bounded integer lanes, widens to binary64 and retains each separate original color-matrix operation and away-from-zero byte rounding. Acquire each row once; no overread, retained row/pixel cache, new buffer, table, allocation or dependency. Complete 4:4:4/grayscale rows only; original padded right-edge, 16-bit, subsampled and scalar production paths remain. Bottom-edge row repetition, component/block/sample order, encoded bytes, work/admission, cancellation and first-failure/output/caller ownership remain unchanged.
algorithmSpecification: Existing owned encoded-space blend and binary64 color policy. For bounded numerator n in [0,65152], floor(n/255) = (n+1+(n>>8))>>8. Preserve original separate multiply/add/subtract operations; no FMA, reassociation or altered precision.

baselineAttribution.scope: Separate accepted post-category warm JPEG encode CPU sampling; actual workload loops including warmup/calibration. Not parity timing.

profileApplicability: Pre-quantization profile identifies still unchanged scalar color/row work; it is not a post-quantization profile or a quantization-specific attribution.

allocationChange.explanation: Inclusive BDN allocation changes are retained rather than declared identical. The automatic measurement calibration uses different operation counts. The strict independent sixteen-encode controls through the actual baseline and measured DLLs retain identical total allocated bytes and identical sorted per-operation allocation values. No added library heap storage is observed.

uncertainty: Two independent three-sample screens guide rank, not uniform-parity certification. Conservative upper divides managed 99.9% Student-t upper mean by the smaller native bracket lower mean with the same critical value. Keep post-run quietness failures and later passing cooldowns.
